usageNote: 名词短语！形容那种经得起考验、掏心掏肺的友情，不是普通点赞之交哦～

examples.en: True friendship means being there for each other even in the hardest times.
examples.zh: 真正的友谊意味着即使在最艰难的时刻也要相互陪伴。

examples.en: I didn't understand the value of true friendship until she stood by me when I failed.
examples.zh: 直到她在我失败时依然支持我，我才明白真正友谊的价值。
